title: The Photo Gallery, Sliders, Proofing and Themes – NextGEN Gallery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored…
description: The NextGEN Gallery plugin for WordPress, versions up to and including 4.5.6, is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'comment' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Exploitation requires the site administrator to have enabled the Thickbox lightbox effect with the 'Try to apply to all images' setting and depends on an administrator approving the attacker's initial comment, which then allows subsequent comments from that author to be auto-approved.
